About the author

Bryan Mooney spent years traveling the globe for business and pleasure and draws upon those experiences when penning his latest novels. He has published over fifteen, including the Nick Ryan mystery thriller series,- The Potus Papers and the sequel, Eye of the Tiger. A recent novel, The Summer of '68- An Odyssey, follows the travels of young Tom Murphy throughout Europe beginning in the summer of 1968 and beyond. A heartwarming coming-of-age story. A prior novel, A Christmas Flower, is set in the small town of River Dale, New Hampshire. Two childhood friends reunite and find after all these years, their feelings for one another have changed.
